# Tech News — anthropic — 2026-07-25

## AI

### Anthropic launches Claude Opus 5 AI model
🔥🔥🔥🔥◯ Anthropic released Claude Opus 5 on July 24, priced at $5 per million input tokens and $25 per million output tokens — unchanged from predecessor Opus 4.8 and half the cost of flagship Claude Fable 5. On coding and knowledge work evaluations like Frontier-Bench and GDPval-AA, Opus 5 is the new state-of-the-art, though it remains behind Mythos 5 on cybersecurity tasks. It ships with a 1M-token context window, an adjustable low/medium/high "effort" setting, and a Fast mode running about 2.5x faster for double the price ($10/$50 per million tokens). It is now the default model on Claude Max and the strongest option on Claude Pro; unlike Fable 5, Opus 5 is not subject to the 30-day data-retention policy, and Anthropic expects safety classifiers to trigger about 85% less often than on Fable 5.

## Funding

### Anthropic prepares for IPO with director-level hiring
🔥🔥◯◯◯ Anthropic is hiring a Director of Investor Relations with a base salary of $425,000 to $600,000 as it prepares for its expected IPO and expands engagement with Wall Street investors. The role will focus on talking to Wall Street investors about the company's business plans and finances before its expected public debut later this year, according to a listing reviewed by the Times of India. A separate report notes the public listing could happen as early as this fall.

Sources: [Google News — Anthropic](https://news.google.?oc=5), [Analytics Insight](https://www.analyticsinsight.net/news/anthropic-strengthens-ipo-plans-with-high-paying-investor-relations-hire)
